scope: Actual successful continuing serial dataflow in12 selected composed32 map cases only: K16/W2 ReferenceA10 arm14(A9/U64),K40/W2 ReferenceA10 arm1(A9/U128),matched ordinary/exact Abseil arms16/17 in each binary,on Zen5 and Granite. No new builds/timings or ELF audits.

source_semantics.digest: For W2, memcpy of both bytes into zero-initialized word; equivalent to unsigned16-bit load. No other payload lanes exist.
source_semantics.source_edge_oracle: Every payload delta independently checked against(next[rank]+6144-rank)%6144 outside timing; complete native phase checks passed in owning receipts.

decision: All12 selected backing-array/recipe successful paths have a true loaded-payload→next-key/hash/address dependency. No constant hit result, Boolean branch or external next[] load replaces the2-byte delta.

limits: Only inspected K16 arm14,K40 arm1 and eachmatched Abseil baseline,ReferenceA10,W2,composed32,onthese two native builds. No broader serial qualification.
Dataflow is for continuing successful lookups. Last iteration exits and missing-key alternatives have0 delta; independent full-hit cycle oracles constrain the measured history.

Abseil binaries include small-table/SOO alternatives. These are excluded from the backing-array proof:6144 distinct live keys cannot use one-element SOO; reserve/build/content oracles establish the large table.
This validates dependency,not lookup-only latency: measured serial operation includes payload digest,rank addition/modulo,key production,hash,lookup and reduction.
No memory-level service,cache-residence,hardware scheduling or performance-causality claim.
